hypothesis: With the project-added full-curve/raw-occupancy admission calls removed and the upstream EGO retry transitions restored, temporary planner infeasibility after the same visible box injection will no longer immediately abort the goal; the planner will keep checking for a feasible obstacle-avoiding trajectory and the PX4/bridge may complete the original target.
single_scenario_variable: Relative to #365, apply only EGO patch 0053 (remove project-added full-curve admission calls and restore upstream retry state transitions after planner infeasibility); keep spawn, goal, planner config, PX4 settings, obstacle, injection timing and observers identical.

injection.trigger: NavigationCommand.target.header.stamp plus 12.0 simulated seconds; the first same-goal B-spline must already have been observed

success_observations: run identity matches the frozen runtime and initial goal/spline are observed
Gazebo acknowledges box creation at the frozen trigger
single D435i/EGO occupancy observations show the injected box surface
same goal_id and epoch publish a replacement trajectory whose geometry avoids the box; traj_id change alone is insufficient
PX4/bridge execute the replacement path and the original position/yaw dwell completes
offline truth and the configured body envelope show positive sampled clearance from the dynamic box; prohibited contacts are zero
planner, bridge, truth and contact observers cover the terminal flight record; final readback is landed, disarmed, control disabled and zero control before container stop

diagnostic_abort.action: caller-cancel through the existing mission path; bridge-owned landing; preserve the run as failed/partial

previous_run_observation.evidence: Same goal/epoch produced trajectory IDs 45–72 after injection; ID 45 still crossed the box, later sampled centerlines cleared its AABB by 0.997–1.539 m. At ~5.5 sim seconds the upstream optimizer logged a refined trajectory collision and returned planning_failed; project patch 0039 immediately aborted the goal.
previous_run_observation.interpretation: The actual route was laterally offset at injection; the 3.27 m value is only the X offset, not full range. The box remained within the 5 m planning horizon by full center range.
